# Synthetic desktop fixture

`peak-inspection-portable.zip` contains two artificial wells (A1/A2), triangular
UV traces, two instrument-integrated peaks of area 700 and 300, and simple test
structure/mass values. It includes an example manual override for A1 and its
original automatic assignment. No private raw RPT is included. The ZIP embeds
its trace images and project metadata and has no external file dependencies.
